column2: A complete small factory floor seen whole on one isometric plate: two machining centres, a conveyor, stock racks and pallets. A second, lighter glowing wireframe layer of the same floor hovers just above it like a lifted copy. The orange accent is one small pallet.

On the left, a small factory floor with two machining centres and a conveyor on an isometric plate. On the right, an identical glowing wireframe copy of the same floor: its digital twin. One thin straight line links the two plates. The orange accent is one small part inside the left machine.
A small gantry crane lowering three plain crates of different sizes onto an empty isometric foundation plate with marked mounting points. The orange accent is the crane hook.

An empty isometric floor plate on the left, a short straight conveyor in the middle, and a small running machine on the right with thin motion lines leaving it. The orange accent is a small start lever at the left end of the conveyor.

A flat blueprint sheet lying on the floor, drawn with a simple floor plan of rectangles and routes. Wireframe machines and a conveyor rise up out of the sheet into 3D on its right half, while the left half stays flat. The orange accent is one corner pin of the sheet.

A small, low production line of three machines and a conveyor on an isometric plate. Behind it floats a smooth translucent ribbon: a fan of many thin overlapping curves that form a soft band, wide at the right. No axes. Exactly one curve in the middle of the band is orange.

A smooth wireframe terrain surface mesh with gentle hills and one clear highest peak. A thin dotted path climbs across the surface to the peak. A tiny factory sits at the foot of the hill. The orange accent is a small marker pin on the peak.

Flat blank table sheets and grid cards glide along thin lines from the left into a central glass cube, and leave on the right as neat stacks of differently shaped tiles. The orange accent is one sheet about to enter the cube.

A small supply network on an isometric plane: a silo, a warehouse with stock racks at different fill levels, and a factory, joined by thin route lines with two small box trucks travelling on them. The orange accent is one nearly empty stock rack.

A queue of small crates waiting on a conveyor in front of a machine. A barrier gate holds some crates back, and a simple sorting arm lifts one crate ahead of the others. The orange accent is the crate being moved to the front.

A wide, low cabinet of open square shelves seen in isometric view. Each cell holds one small different factory object: a gear, a crate, a gauge, a spool, a pallet, a valve, a small machine. The orange accent is one single object.

Above a small factory plate float two long smooth curves, one solid and one dashed, that almost overlap. A precision caliper measures the small gap between them, and a round unmarked dial sits beside it. The orange accent is the dial pointer.

A plain keyboard and a blank dark slab screen on an isometric desk plate. A thin line runs from the screen to a small factory model on the right. The screen shows only three short plain horizontal bars and one block cursor. The orange accent is the block cursor.

Three blank floating glass panels in isometric view, like windows with no writing. One shows a simple floor map of rectangles and routes, one shows a soft band chart shape, one shows plain bars. The orange accent is one rectangle on the floor map.
A machine with one side panel swung open, showing gears inside. A magnifying lens and a wrench rest beside it on the floor plate. The orange accent is one gear inside the machine.

A long horizontal rail with a row of sockets. Several interchangeable blocks of the same width but different inner patterns are plugged in, and one block hovers just above an empty socket, ready to slot in. The orange accent is the hovering block.

Three differently shaped plugs on cables come from server racks on the left and dock into one universal socket block in the middle. From the socket block a single line runs to a small factory on the right. The orange accent is one plug that is just connecting.

A central hub cube with ports on its sides. Small packet cubes travel along thin lines in both directions between the hub and three small blank panels around it. The orange accent is one packet in transit.

Five wide, thin, translucent slabs stacked with air gaps between them in an exploded isometric view. Thin arrows point straight down from each slab to the one below. Each slab has a different simple wire pattern. The orange accent is the bottom slab edge.

A path of eleven small isometric floor tiles laid out left to right like stepping stones, joined by a thin glowing line. Each tile carries one small factory object: a press, a crate, a gauge, a conveyor segment, a gear, a flag. The orange accent is the first tile on the left.

An open box frame on the left. From it, a few floating wireframe blocks travel to the right and slot together into a half-assembled injection moulding press on an empty isometric floor plate. The orange accent is the last block about to slot in.

Flat blank sheets and small stacks of plain round discs like coins glide along a thin line into the side of a wireframe injection moulding press. On the other side of the press sit three neat pallets of finished parts. The orange accent is one stack of discs.

A wireframe injection moulding press on a floor plate passes under a thin rectangular scanning gate. A flat sheet of light from the gate sweeps across the press. The orange accent is one small part of the press that the light has found.

One small press line of a press and a conveyor in front, bright. Behind it, the same press line repeats as a long row of fainter and fainter ghost copies that fade into the distance to the right. The orange accent is one crate on the front conveyor.

Two machining centres on a floor plate. A queue of ten small identical crates moves along a conveyor through the machines toward a simple finish gate on the right. The orange accent is one crate that is still far from the gate.

Three short conveyor lanes, each carrying a different shape of part (cubes, cylinders, flat plates), meet at one rail junction with a single switch lever. One lane continues from the junction into an injection moulding press. The orange accent is the switch lever.

A small factory building with a conveyor on a floor plate, and a low equipment rack beside it. Four different instrument modules slot into the rack: a balance scale, a lens, an unmarked gauge dial and a panel with one wave curve. The orange accent is the pointer of the balance scale.

Five parallel straight conveyor lanes side by side like a race track, each carrying one identical crate. The crates are at different distances along the lanes. A thin finish gate crosses all lanes on the right. The orange accent is the crate that leads.

Seven round platform discs of different sizes float above the grid, joined by curved arrows of different thickness, some looping back to the same disc. One disc is clearly the largest. The orange accent is one small disc at the edge.

A large precise balance scale. Each pan holds one wireframe cube of the same size, and one pan hangs clearly lower. Behind the beam, a thin horizontal band marks a margin. The orange accent is the cube on the lower pan.

A long, low control console in isometric view with a neat row of unmarked sliders and round unmarked dials. Thin lines run from the console to a small factory building with a chimney beside it. The orange accent is one slider knob.
